01 / About

Building at the meeting point of people and systems.

I’m Kyle Tyree, a full-stack software developer based in Amherst, Virginia.

I studied web development and business information systems at Liberty University, then spent eight years working across IT, database administration, and the web at a regional engineering firm. Since 2022, I’ve been a full-stack software developer at a university in Virginia, building web applications.

I care about the parts of technology people actually feel: whether the next step is obvious, whether the details hold together, and whether the finished thing earns its place.
